I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is #4092.

That number comes from Ilse in #north-random yesterday (Oct 13), a channel Dana is in. Ilse said IT has #4092 open to replace the hub. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I passed that warning on to Dana too.

Dana's private guess about the ticket number came to me in a direct message, so I left it out of the channel.
